details: The ResizeObserver fires renderChart() on every resize event with no debounce or RAF coalescing, causing full SVG teardown and re-creation at 60fps during window resize across all 6 panels simultaneously. All other interaction patterns are sound: pointer events unify mouse/touch, there are no D3 transitions to interrupt, scales are freshly created per render so no stale closures, and cross-view highlights use direct function calls rather than dispatched events so no feedback loops are possible.
